prompt_template:
A square spell icon for an original fantasy strategy game's spellbook: one finished square image, 1:1, shown in the game at 128 and 64 pixels.

Spell: {name}, a tier {tier} {kind} spell of the {school_label}. {mechanic}
Subject: {subject}.
Composition: one clear subject, centred and filling about three quarters of the square, with a bold silhouette that still reads at 64 pixels. {look}
Style: richly painted original fantasy game art, painterly realism with crisp material detail and hand-painted texture; clean, dramatic light from the subject itself.
Palette and materials: {palette}.
Constraints: an original design; no text, letters, numbers, runes that look like letters, watermark or UI elements; no symbols or designs from existing games or franchises; the whole square is painted, edge to edge, with no transparent areas.
look_template: No ring, frame or border: the subject itself is the emblem, set against a deep {bg} background with a soft {glow} glow behind it that fades to near black at the edges of the square.
